speaker: john_heminges
text: Item. The gentlemen are done. This is a reckoning, not a hope. Your share, William, is twenty-two shillings.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Twenty-two. Say the pile, so I do not love the wrong coins.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Twenty-two shillings. A pound and two shillings, in silver. I am not rounding it up to please the room, and I am not paying the gown out of it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The gown is fifty shillings, unpaid, against the Queen's twenty pounds, which are not here. I am not offering my twenty-two against that fifty.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Item. The fifty stands. Edith's eight stands. Neither comes off your share. Her sleeves were never your bargain, and I will not make them one on a Saturday night.

speaker: margery_pell
text: I have our stair, and I have no figure for the Rose. They bill a Tasso. I do not gather their door. I did not go, and I will not father a receipt I did not see.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I did not go. I was in the gentlemen. A title is not a sum. Do not write one for me.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: Nothing was bought. The K in the book is a K. There is no digit under it. I will not mint one so the page looks finished.

speaker: will_kemp
text: I am not begging a digit, John. I am asking whether Wednesday's longer pass is a blank tonight. You, Will. I am still saying you. I can number my own laughs without borrowing your pen.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Laughs are not a share. Abel has given me a blank, and a blank is what I enter. I do not pay a letter.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: There is no figure, Will. I asked which lines were better. You did not name them. I will not invent a number where the names should have been.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Item. The coffer stays upstairs. I am not carrying it down to keep a share company. Twenty-two shillings is this line. The rest of the money in the house is not this line.

speaker: margery_pell
text: Then write the twenty-two, and write that I brought nothing from over the water. My stair is not their door.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: And I am not writing a new stock. An old figure can stay where it was last said. Tonight is a share, not a new sentence about the stock.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Leave the stock. My twopence to the carrier is mine. It does not come off the twenty-two, and it does not go into the company book.

speaker: john_heminges
text: It is not in my book. Item. Twenty-two shillings to you. The fifty unpaid. The eight unpaid. The Queen's twenty pounds not in this room. I am not calling any of those a share.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Then I am rich in lines nobody will number, and you are rich in twenty-two shillings, and the gown remains a ghost. A ghost is not my business. I said so of the watchet, and I say so again.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The gown stays with John's mercer and with money we have not got. I am taking the twenty-two home. I am not paying a debt with it on the stair.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Count them before you are fond of them. A pound, and two shillings. If you are short, say so here.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: A pound, and two shillings. I have them. I am not short.

speaker: margery_pell
text: Then I am done. The house was an ordinary house. I am not painting it.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: And the K is a K in the dark as it was in the morning. I will not start a total because the parlour is tired.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Item. Done. Twenty-two shillings to William. Nothing to the fifty. Nothing to the eight. Nothing imagined for the Rose.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then I am going. The leaf at home is still unsent. This silver does not send it.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Good night, Will. Be as courteous to the silver as you were to me on Wednesday. It has done less to annoy you.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Good night. The silver is a share. You are not a sum.
